text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer is upon us. Everyone else is on a
bus
headed toward the summer camp
site...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This year, however, one Umamusume is
boarding
an airplane headed for the
other side of the
planet.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, Taiki. We're entrusting all of
our hopes
and dreams to you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But I'm not worried! Knowing you, you
can
overcome any pressure that comes
your way!
Believe in yourself and do
your best out there.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You bet, Pearl! I'll go out there and
wrangle me
back a surefire victory! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That sounds like a promise!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(I'm counting on you, Taiki. As someone
whose
strength I've acknowledged as
bona fide, there's
no doubt you can do
this...)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? What are you doing? Aren't you
going to
offer Taiki some encourage—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What are you looking at?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hm? What about them?
choice_data_list: The structure of the expedition team...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Who and what is Taiki Shuttle bringing
with her
abroad? I take notes on
everything from the
personnel to the
equipment for reference.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps this information will prove
useful one
day. After all, our own
venture overseas isn't off
the table just
yet.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I see. You're looking into the
distant
future.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Good thinking. After all, maybe this is
what
awaits us too at the end of the
winding road
someday...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The plane that Seeking the Pearl could
very well
have been on departs for
France.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Welp, let's get to training!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
While Taiki is off taking on the world,
we have
our own immense wall to break
through!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm talking about the wall of
speed!
Even if I can't match Taiki in
overall ability...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This summer, I'll beat her in terms of
speed! Are
you on board?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Great! Let's smash spectacularly through
our
goals this summer...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And keep comfortable as we watch Taiki
take on
the world stage! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's right. We haven't given up. In
fact, that's
precisely why we decided to
remain in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're putting everything on the line this
summer
in order to shine even brighter.
